Promise, promise, o my love,
Thou wilt wait in boughs above,
That our leaves might bloom together.

Though time hath torn thee from my arms,
And time hath wrought us countless harms,
Time shall make us one forever.
"This is a sad love song handed down in Arboria since ancient times, mourning a lover lost to death.
"I don't know who left such a song in the village of the Keepers, but I've loved it since I was a girl.
"Since the day the Tree fell, something has weighed on my heart.
"...Veronica.
"You and I will bud and fall at the same time, won't we?
"You're always so slow, Serena. I wonder.
"...But I hope we do.
"Serena, promise me. Whatever happens to me, you'll live on alone.
"...I can't promise that. I can't imagine you being gone.
"I've long regretted it. If I had promised then, Veronica could have gone to heaven at ease...
"Veronica was right, I was slow. Learning words and spells, walking, everything, I was behind her...
"But to be left behind first, even at a time like this...
"{var:1}, I'm sorry. Please let me cry beside you for a little while, just a little...
"Sorry, {var:1}. My heart's doubt has finally cleared.
"This life Veronica saved... I'll pass it on to the future with all my might.

...What!
Serena drew a knife and cut her long hair in one stroke!
"...I won't show tears anymore.
"...Farewell.
Serena gently held her hair up to the sky.
"What is this...?
"This power... could it be...?
"This power... could it be...?
"Was that flame Veronica's? Her spells... I can use them too now...
"Thank you... Veronica.
"Thank you... Veronica.
Veronica's spells and skills were passed on to Serena!
